snippet.textDisplay:
I feel like Sean's a little confused about how the criminal profile works. At 2:52:39 he's like "why is my criminal profile going up, shouldn't it be good that I'm not [killing them]?" When it goes up, it means you're a "clean" criminal who commits crimes in a less violent/non-violent manner. When it goes down, it means that you're a violent criminal (explanation of that is in the name). Jason and Lucia are judged separately. Different ranks have different actions that increase focus. Here's a list of the ranks:

• Professional: Reached through stealth, peaceful choices, and non-lethal approaches. Stealth or peaceful actions build your focus meter at this rank.
• Hardened: The starting rank for both Jason and Lucia, where stealth and peaceful actions increase focus.
• Violent: Driven by frequent lethal force and shooting. Headshots increase your focus meter.
• Psycho: Tied to reckless, heavy violence. Police stop accepting surrenders. Headshots build focus.
• Irredeemable: The extreme end of the scale for severe, repeated violence. It provides no focus bonus and cannot be improved once reached

Your criminal profile does not determine how good or bad you are at crime, and it doesn't determine whether you're a "good person" or not like the RDR honor system. When it goes up, it doesn't mean you're "more" of a criminal. It simply shows how you choose to commit crimes and determines how those choices affect your gameplay
